title: Environment variables for serverless jobs are in Beta
body: Environment variables for serverless Lakeflow Jobs tasks are in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). You can define named environment variable entries at the job level and select one for each task to pass deployment-specific configuration to your application code. A workspace admin must enable the preview from the workspace **Previews** page. See [Configure environment variables for serverless jobs](/aws/en/jobs/environment-variables).
